description: Dry-run an EVM transaction with nothing signed: the local guards (native cap, token cap, fee cap), the spend policy, the node's gas estimate (which fails when the call would revert), the worst-case fee, whether the balance covers it, and the call's return data. Local mode runs the full check; hosted mode runs the policy and an eth_call.

value.description: Native amount in human units (e.g. "0.01" ETH)

name: simulate_transaction
